confirm.resetBody: {{count}} user(s) get a new temporary password. Their current password and every open session stop working.
confirm.printBody: A login slip shows a password, and stored passwords cannot be read back. So {{count}} user(s) first get a new temporary password; their current password and sessions stop working.
confirm.blockBody: {{count}} user(s) are signed out and cannot sign in until you unblock them.
confirm.moveBody: {{count}} student(s) leave their current class and its courses and join the courses of the new class.

slips.title: New sign-in details
slips.warning: These passwords are shown only now. Print or copy them before you close this window.
slips.name: Name
slips.heading: Campusly sign-in
slips.rule: This password works for 3 sign-ins or 14 days. After that you set your own password.

add.studentSubtitle: Fill in the details, then save to get the sign-in details.
add.teacherSubtitle: A staff account. The teacher signs in on the teacher portal.
add.title: Title
add.findParent: Find a parent by name or phone
add.linkNote: If this phone already exists, the child is linked to that parent — no new login is created.
add.parentOptional: Leave all parent fields empty to add a parent later.
add.parentIncomplete: Fill in every parent field or leave them all empty.
add.idExplain: ID = year {{year}} + role {{role}} + number {{seq}} · unique, given by the system
add.parentIdExplain: Parent ID = the last 9 digits of the phone.
add.tempNote: The temporary password works for 3 sign-ins or 14 days. Then they set their own.
add.existingAccount: Existing account: now linked to this child, keeps their own password.
add.partial: The student was saved, but the second parent was not: {{error}}

import.title: Import students
import.limits: Up to 300 students, 100 KB. Columns: first_name, last_name, class, admission_year, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_relation.
import.optIds: Generate Student IDs and temporary passwords
import.optParents: Create parent logins (ID = last 9 digits of the phone, temporary password)
import.footnote: After the import you get all login slips on one page to print or save as PDF.
import.previewNote: Preview IDs are not reserved: if someone adds a student meanwhile, the numbers move up.
import.doneBody: New parent accounts and links to existing parents are included. {{skipped}} rows with errors were skipped.
